name: Legal & Corporate Law
description: Statutory, contract, and litigation terminology for legal seminars and executive summits.

entries.domain_definition: A contractual agreement by one party to hold harmless and compensate another for legal damages or losses.
An ethical and legal obligation of highest loyalty and care to act solely in the best interest of another party.
The formal theoretical study, philosophy, and institutional body of legal doctrines and court interpretations.
The legal right of one party to substitute into another party's position to collect third-party damages.
A contractual clause stating that if any portion is declared unenforceable, the remaining terms remain binding.
A legal bar preventing someone from asserting a right or fact that contradicts their own previous actions or claims.
A formal, legally binding solemn pledge or operational restriction established within an agreement or deed.
An authoritative judicial court order commanding a party to halt a specific activity or perform an affirmative act.
